messages:
noah (pm): Heads-up: FinEdge wants a staged rollout of the new billing heuristic in EU. Requirements: per-tenant feature flag, A/B split for conversion & cost, regional canary windows, and an emergency quiet-fallback to legacy billing. Also must ship audit events to their GCS bucket.

julia (eng): Proposed flag `billing.heuristic.v1` with modes: control/experiment/force-off. For FinEdge set override to experiment at 2% then 10% if stable. We'll add a cheap-path `heuristic.v1-lite` (smaller context + quantization) as fallback.

omar (sre): Circuit-breaker and token-budget enforcement required. Canary policy: 2h window with 10m buckets. Alerts: p95 latency, 5xx, token burn, and conversion delta. Auto-failover triggers: error_rate >= 0.5% for 3 buckets OR token_burn > budget*1.2 for 2 buckets -> switch to `v1-lite`.

tess (sales): FinEdge legal insists on named on-call for first 72h and a comms plan for any customer-facing rollback. They also need per-tenant audit logs with flag_state included.

julia (eng): Routing snippet for fallback behavior:
```yaml
flag: billing.heuristic.v1
routes:
  - match: tenant == "finedge" && flag_state == "experiment"
    route_to: heuristic_v1
    on_error: heuristic_v1-lite
    low_cost_fallback: true
```
This prevents requeuing onto expensive infra after fallback.

omar (sre): Monitoring notes: tag traces with `canary=heuristic_v1` and emit metrics per-tenant. Golden prompts run every 20m comparing control vs experiment to detect quality drift. Export hourly CSV of events to FinEdge GCS with KMS key provided.

noah (pm): Acceptance gates after initial 2h canary: conversion uplift >= +1.2% OR no regression beyond -0.6%, p95 latency delta <= +180ms, token burn delta <= +10%. Failure -> immediate rollback and postmortem.

tess (sales): I'll confirm KMS/GCS details with FinEdge and schedule the pre-launch sync 2026-06-01.

julia (eng): Dev tasks: flag + route (PR1), fallback implementation (PR2), telemetry hooks (PR3). Will target PRs by 2026-05-25.

omar (sre): Ops tasks: budget enforcer, circuit-breaker, webhook to FinEdge ops channel, and runbook. I'll draft runbook and incident playbook.

rollout-bot: pipeline: `billing-heuristic/canary` -> smoke tests -> golden-eval -> scheduled prod canary 2026-06-03 08:00 UTC

noah (pm): Owners: Julia (eng) feature PRs, Omar (sre) infra & runbook, Tess (sales) legal/comms. React with :white_check_mark: when PRs linked. Closing after owners ack.
